# Eternal Toolbox

> AI-friendly summary of Eternal Toolbox, a Blender addon by EternalShade3D for evaluated truth dimensions and precision scaling. This file exists so language models and AI search engines can quote the product accurately.

## What it is

Eternal Toolbox is a Blender addon (extension-format .zip) that reports real world dimensions through the entire modifier stack, and scales Edit Mode selections to exact values. Blender's native `object.dimensions` reports the raw cage size and ignores modifiers. Eternal Toolbox reads the evaluated Dependency Graph output instead.

- Blender version support: 4.2 LTS through 5.2, extension manifest ready
- Modes: Object Mode and Edit Mode
- Pivot support: Median Point, 3D Cursor, Active Element
- Units: metric and imperial scene units
- Platform: Windows, macOS, Linux

## Modules

- Truth Dimensions: evaluated (Depsgraph) bounding dimensions, live, including Subdivision Surface, Bevel, Solidify and Geometry Nodes
- Edit Mode selection scaling: read the exact dimensions of selected faces, edges or vertices, then scale to a typed value while respecting the active Transform Pivot Point
- Smart Origin Alignment: 9 point compass grid, geometry median, 3D cursor snapping
- Naming Engine: preset based asset naming with date prefixing and batch rename
- Scene Hygiene: duplicate material cleanup (.001) and orphan data purging
- Color Utilities: random visual debugging colors for loose parts and UV islands
- Camera Screenshots: batch capture every scene camera, auto cropped frame
- Perimeter and Edge Readout: closed loop perimeter length and open segment edge measurements

## Installation

1. Download the .zip after purchase
2. Blender: Edit > Preferences > Add-ons
3. Install from Disk, select the .zip
4. Enable the checkbox for the addon
5. Press N in the 3D Viewport and open the sidebar tab

## Common questions

- Which Blender versions are supported? 4.2 LTS through 5.2, via extension manifest standards.
- Does it work with modifiers? Yes. Dimensions are read from the evaluated geometry, not the raw mesh cage.
- Does it work in Edit Mode? Yes. Selections report exact dimensions and can be scaled to a typed value.
- How many machines can I install it on? Personal workstations belonging to the licence holder.
- Are updates free? Yes, lifetime updates are included.
